title: Is my site indexed? A checklist builder
description: Type your domain, get the exact links and steps to check whether Google and Bing have found your site, and what to do if they haven't.

title: Redirect map builder: old URLs to new, for any server
description: Paste old and new URLs and get ready-to-paste 301 redirect rules for .htaccess, nginx, Netlify, Cloudflare and Vercel, with loops, chains and duplicates caught first.

title: robots.txt tester: is this URL blocked, and by which line?
description: Paste a robots.txt and a list of URLs, pick the bots, and see which URLs each bot may crawl, the exact line that decided it, and the mistakes in the file.

title: Check your SPF, DKIM and DMARC records: a free paste-in checker
description: Paste your domain's SPF, DKIM and DMARC records and see what each part means, what's broken, and whether you meet Gmail's sender rules, without sending anything anywhere.

title: Can AI assistants find your business? A free check
description: Get three questions to ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini about your business, score what they answered, and paste your robots.txt to see whether it blocks the bots that put you in their answers.

title: Business hours and LocalBusiness structured data: a free builder
description: Fill in your business details and opening hours once, and get LocalBusiness JSON-LD that follows Google's rules plus a plain-text hours list for your page that matches it.

title: Read your DMARC reports: a free reader that opens the .zip and .gz files
description: Drop in the DMARC aggregate reports from Google, Microsoft and others and see every server sending email as your domain, which ones fail and what to fix, without uploading anything.

title: Sitemap checker: find the mistakes in your sitemap.xml
description: Paste your sitemap.xml or sitemap.txt, or drop the file (.xml, .xml.gz or .txt), and see every mistake Google cares about: broken XML, relative or mixed-host URLs, duplicates, bad lastmod dates and size limits, without sending anything anywhere.
